next.reason: 1985: START 'Data-name-1 may be qualified.' The 2023 START clause has no rule of its own, but qualification is general: §2023:5.2.4 makes every user-defined-word operand of a format mean the word 'including qualification and subscripting if needed'; §2023:8.4.2.2.3 SR1 requires qualification for a non-unique name and §2023:8.4.2.2.3 SR2 says 'A name may be qualified even though it does not need qualification'. Nothing in §2023:14.9.41.3 forbids it, so a qualified START KEY data-name is accepted as in 1985.
